issue.title: UI & UX - Mockups
issue.description:
## 🔧 Tech Story
As a developer,
I want to design mockups for the main features,
so that the interface is validated before implementation begins.

logs.description: Created the mockups for: User not logged in; User logged in; User drop down menu with log out button; Login page.
Updating mockups after discussion with M. Sahli

Created the mockups for the main CRUD functionality. My recipes page where user can see and manage (edit, delete, view) their recipes and create new ones; The create recipe page + form which is the same form the edit functionality uses; View recipe page.
